svg.title: The parts of a polar area chart
svg.desc: A polar area chart of support tickets by day of the week, with seven equal wedges starting at the centre. Callouts mark the rings, which are labelled with real values and are not evenly spaced in value, the equal angle of every wedge, and the largest wedge, whose radius is the square root of its value so that its area matches the value.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
